seo.description_so: BajGo waa shirkad Garoowe ah oo bixisa safar iyo dirid Bajaaj ah. Baro himiladayada iyo sida aan u shaqeyno.
seo.description_en: BajGo is a Garowe company offering Bajaaj rides and deliveries. Learn about our mission and how we work.

so.headline: Darawallo deegaanka ah. Qiimo cad. Garoowe marka hore.
so.sub: BajGo waa app-ka Bajaajta ee Garoowe ee safarka iyo dirista alaabta. Waxaan ka shaqeynaa in safarka iyo dirista ay noqdaan kuwo ammaan ah, caddaalad ah oo degdeg ah.

en.headline: Local drivers. Fair fares. Garowe first.
en.sub: BajGo is Garowe's on-demand Bajaaj app for rides and deliveries. We work to make getting around and sending things safe, fair and instant.

so.title: Himiladayada
so.body:
Inaan safarka iyo u dirista alaabta Garoowe ka dhigno mid ammaan ah, caddaalad ah oo degdeg ah, iyadoo darawallada Bajaajta la siinayo dakhli joogto ah oo sharaf leh.

## Aragtidayada

Inaan noqonno shabakadda gaadiidka ee ugu kalsoonida badan Puntland iyo magaalooyinka Soomaaliyeed.

## Sida aan u shaqeyno

- **La isku halleyn karo.** Waxaan yimaadnaa marka la ballamo. Qiimaha waxaa la tusaa ka hor safarka, wax yaab ah ma jiro.
- **Degdeg.** Dalbasho degdeg ah, imaatin degdeg ah, akhris degdeg ah.
- **Diirran.** Dadka waxaan u salaamnaa sida deris. Waxaan ixtiraamnaa rakaabka iyo darawallada labadaba.
- **Ku faanka Garoowe.** Waddooyinka deegaanka, darawallada deegaanka, luqadda deegaanka marka hore.
- **Casri.** Tiknoolajiyad nadiif ah oo qof kasta isticmaali karo.

## Darawallada waa shuraako

Isla darawalladu waxay qabtaan safarrada iyo diristaba. Waxay arkaan dakhliga safar kasta, waxayna shaqeeyaan waqtiga iyaga ku habboon.

en.title: Our mission
en.body:
To make getting around and sending things in Garowe safe, fair and instant, while giving Bajaaj drivers steady, dignified income.

## Our vision

To become the most trusted mobility network in Puntland and across Somali cities.

## How we work

- **Dependable.** We show up when promised. Fares are shown before the trip, no surprises.
- **Quick.** Fast to book, fast to arrive, fast to read.
- **Warm.** We greet people like a neighbour, and respect riders and drivers alike.
- **Proud of Garowe.** Local streets, local drivers, local language first.
- **Modern.** Clean, confident technology that anyone can use.

## Drivers are partners

The same drivers do rides and deliveries. They see the earnings for every trip and work the hours that suit them.
